name: Liar's Maze
source:
"All I need is this spell of my own making, one more time, one more time, one more time..."

Made in celebration of Halloween 2020, this game focuses on an alternate reality featuring characters from the comic Space School. You do not need to have read Space School in order to play and enjoy this game, though it is encouraged.

[Edited from [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/liarsmaze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「我只需要這道自創的咒語，再一次，再一次，再一次……」

本作為慶祝2020年萬聖節而製作，描寫漫畫《Space School》角色們在另一重現實中的故事。即便沒有讀過漫畫，也可以遊玩並享受本作，不過仍推薦先閱讀原作。

［編譯自[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/liarsmaze]itch.io[/url]］
